name: Cooper*
summary: Revival of Oswald Cooper's Cooper family, from Regular to Cooper Black, in six weights with italics.
description: Historically accurate digital revival of Oswald Cooper's Cooper family, running from the expressive Regular to the iconic Cooper Black and researched from the 1923 Barnhart Brothers & Spindler catalog, the 1934 American Type Founders catalog and the 1949 Book of Oz Cooper. Six weights with italics, ornamental characters, and support for over 50 languages. Free to download under the SIL Open Font License; the variable font version costs $20 or more.
